verdict.rationale: Discord's webhooks docs state that apps can 'receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP' [discord-docs-56], which is outbound webhook event delivery. Its richer event stream, the Gateway, uses WebSockets rather than webhooks [discord-docs-20], and incoming webhooks only post messages into channels [discord-docs-5]. Missing for 10: documented list of subscribable webhook event types, how subscriptions are configured, signature/verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
